_comment: Synthetic IF selection aggregate for Issue #1705 (dominated-branch collapse). An IF aggregate selects its positive or negative branch based on a condition synapse. Here the RELU branch is wired as the positive branch (always >= 0) and the ABSOLUTE-scaled-by-(-1) branch as the negative branch (always <= 0, analytically dominated whenever the condition selects positive). The IF condition synapse (type=condition) is driven by neuron-cond. Fixtures only - no engine behaviour change. Input neurons are implicit (referenced as input-N).
